description: This PHP source file generates a dashboard chart visualization for lead sources within the SugarCRM or VTigerCRM system. It retrieves user preferences, fetches lead source data, manages cache files for generated images, and outputs an HTML page with a chart and optional editing controls for customizing the lead source dashboard.

classes.name: jpgraph
classes.description: A class responsible for creating and rendering various types of charts for the dashboard, specifically the lead source pipeline chart in this context.

methods.name: pipeline_by_lead_source
methods.description: Generates and outputs an image of a pipeline chart based on lead source data, either by rendering directly or returning the image content.
